parameters.query:
with u as (
  update lawnet.lawyers set verification = $2::lawnet.verification_status, verified_by = $3,
         verified_at = case when $2 = 'verified' then now() else verified_at end
  where id = $1::uuid returning id, public_ref, full_name, email, whatsapp_e164, hubspot_contact_id, verification)
, v as (insert into lawnet.verifications(lawyer_id, method, result, checked_by)
        select id, 'bar_register_lookup', verification, $3 from u)
select * from u;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $json.whatsapp_e164.replace('+',''), type: 'template', template: { name: 'lawnet_lawyer_verified', language: { code: 'en' }, components: [ { type: 'body', parameters: [ { type: 'text', text: String($json.full_name) }, { type: 'text', text: String($json.public_ref) } ] } ] } }) }}

parameters.subject: You are verified – referrals are now open
parameters.html:
={{ `

Dear ${$json.full_name},

Your bar admission is confirmed (ref ${$json.public_ref}). You will now receive anonymised candidate/employer cases that match your countries, routes and languages. Please accept or decline each case within ${$('Config').first().json.cfg.lawyerSlaHours} hours.

` }}
